points.text: Relay coil shown connected between diode and earth.
For diode to conduct, current flow is into output of op-amp; or when earth is at higher potential diode is forward biased; or diode blocks current when output positive; or diode must conduct.
points.guidance: Official M1. Method prerequisite for the following dependent A mark. Any one of these alternatives earns the single M1.
Official A1. Dependent on the preceding M mark being earned.
